title: Onboard Stripe 500: leftover four-id CHECK on entitlements
description:
## Why
Live PUT /api/admin/tenants/:id/connectors/stripe returns 500 Internal server error. CP log: new row for tenant_connector_entitlements violates tenant_connector_entitlements_connector_id_check.

Migrate lp-hdzm.4 tried to drop CHECKs matching ILIKE '%connector_id IN%'. Postgres stores IN-lists as connector_id = ANY (ARRAY[...]), so the drop never fired on live RDS. Greenfield CREATE TABLE no longer has the CHECK, so tests passed.

Onboard from /admin is the intended path (not chat).

## Acceptance
- Migrate drops four-id CHECKs whether Postgres stored IN or = ANY
- PUT entitlement for stripe succeeds after remigrate
- Prove with CP integration test that plants the ANY-form CHECK then remigrates
close_reason: Live PUT stripe entitlement 500'd on leftover tenant_connector_entitlements_connector_id_check. Postgres stores IN as = ANY; migrate now drops both. PR #717 merged 36a87cec. CP :39 digest 63a3ae25 HEALTHY (migrate on boot). Retry onboard from /admin. Chat is not the path.

title: Registry promote 400s when catalog summary exceeds CP label max
description:
## Why
Live POST /api/admin/registry/promote for stripe.com returns 400 Validation failed (29-byte body). CloudFront x-cache Error from cloudfront is the origin 400, not a CF rewrite.

Live integrations.sh stripe.com summary is 175 chars. Promote uses that as canonical label. CP insertCanonicalConnectorSchema.label max is 128. BFF forwards CP error.error only, so the UI sees Validation failed with no field details.

Fixture summary is short, so tests never caught it.

## Acceptance
- Promote stripe.com with the live 175-char summary returns 201 and label "Stripe" (or another <=128 name)
- BFF never sends a label longer than CP max
- Prove with unit + registry write test
close_reason: Live integrations.sh stripe.com summary is 175 chars; CP label max 128. Promote now title-cases the slug when summary is too long. PR #716 merged 443af5c0. BFF :54 digest 5265501b HEALTHY. Retry Registry → Stripe → Promote.
